subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. C sits third to the right of D. E sits second to the right of C. F is the immediate neighbour of B and C. G is not an immediate neighbour of D. How many people sit between A and G when counted from the left of G?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

C sits third to the right of D.

E sits second to the right of C.
